_note: Radiotelephony designators (ICAO three-letter designator -> telephony word) for the operators in data/<CODE>/traffic.json. telephony is as published in FAA Order JO 7340.2P Contractions, Chapter 3 Section 1 (ICAO aircraft company three-letter identifier and telephony designator assignments), which follows ICAO Doc 8585. say is how the browser's speech synthesis is told to pronounce it: a spelling chosen for this project, not published data. Every operator in a traffic.json must have an entry (tests/unit/phraseology.test.js).

_source.doc: FAA Order JO 7340.2P Contractions, Chapter 3 Section 1
